name: Akuryou Gakuen Reiko
source:
Ashura Reiko, a young girl born in an ancient psychic family, challenges a strange case by making use of its special ability. Miserable incidents occur one after another at a prestigious girls' high school which are linked to a horrible mysterious occult circle secret.

[Edited From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
